# ADR 0004: Explicit workflow state machine with audit

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Consumer complaints triage and SLA service

## Context

Illegal status changes and missing history are regulatory findings.

## Decision

Model statuses as an enum with an allowed-transition table; reject illegal transitions (409) and append every change to an audit table.

## Consequences

Predictable, auditable lifecycle.

## Alternatives considered

Free-form status updates.
